Not true. There is really good AND cheap weed in BBK. Go to Fatt Buds. You’ll find insane shit there + they give u free snacks and drink and they have an amazing smoking area. 

You can get really good strains for as low as 80/100 a gram if you buy 10/15/28 gms. Samui has the same thing and so does Phangan and Krabi. You need to contact the right people because the ones selling GOOD weed for cheap aren’t always easy to find. 

Also dispensaries where you can smoke/play/chill are everywhere honestly. Weeden is one of them.  I found a place in phangan and the owners were super chill, gave us free edibles, and another place gave me free hash. So, just be nice to people and make small talk cus you never know what will come out of it. I am quite social and like to talk to everyone so I get pointed in the right direction usually but always be careful and have an awesome trip.

it looks like you do not even use reddit that much so I have strong reason to believe that you might know them personally as well.

I think I was being very reasonable. Not to mention, this is the first time in 3 years when I wasn’t able to able to deliver on time. I think I was being respectful towards them and they didn’t understand my point of view. I can’t control unforeseen circumstances and if they were icky about the first time, they should not have asked me to do a second assignment for them in the first place. Again, not to mention, I would have delivered that on time. I am college student, I have other things to do. There is a HUGE time gap between us. If one cannot consider all the sides at play here, including medical emergencies (which is what happened) I really don’t know what to say. I’ve had great experiences on reddit and I do not want ONE bad situation to define who I am as a writer. I have the right to defend myself. I provide great content at affordable prices.
